summary: vdd-execution-plan creates/repairs complete VDD execution-plan directories only on explicit request; standalone requirements Markdown routes to direct implementation. Before action read solo-maintainer standard, clarification gate, and lifecycle contract. Select least-complex profile first: standard, resumable, or self-hosted; pass profile to model routing. Lifecycle: draft -> plan-ready -> implementation-authorized -> implementation-complete -> acceptance-passed -> archived. Clarify only material scope, compatibility, destructive, protected-path, or acceptance boundaries; zero questions valid. Each slice needs behavior, failure intent, GREEN target, dependents, and recovery; VDD does not own RED execution. Repair is in-place under repair/round-n, preserves history, uses lineageFamilyId, default two rounds/hard limit three with typed Round-3 triggers. Repair requires hash-bound changed-set derivation, root-cause callsite inventory, producer/consumer composition receipt, and complete review scope. Mandatory knowledge preflight and skill-input consumption gate precede plan generation; missing verified required knowledge or invalid receipts blocks plan-ready. Use explicit target-plan paths; no automatic promotion from search results. Standard may omit 95 report; resumable/self-hosted require append-only 95 report and index entry. Bootstrap is optional supplemental evidence and never publishes lifecycle state. Completion requires profile artifacts, observable acceptance for every requirement, RED/legacy path, stable repairs, and current terminal full validation.
